newsitem.title: FRANCE: No BoF tender Thurs but council mtg to go ahead.
newsitem.headline: No BoF tender Thurs but council mtg to go ahead.

text.p: The Bank of France said there would be no security repurchase tender on Thursday but that its monetary policy council meeting would go ahead that day as planned.
If the council chooses to make an announcement after its morning meeting, it would do so at the time it normally carries out the tender at 1215 GMT, a Bank spokeswoman said.
"If there is an announcement, it will be at the time we normally do it, around 1315 (1215 GMT), a Bank spokeswoman said.
The securities repurchase tender was cancelled due to timing problems caused by two back-to-back holidays this weekend and next, Bank said.
With November 1 and November 11 as public holidays the schedule of repurchase tenders has been changed to the following:

The securities repurchase tender held October 24 will expire on November 5, that of the October 28 will expire on November 8, that of November 4 will expire on November 15 and that of November 7 will expire on November 19.
